about: I am a communications professional with more than ten years of experience in strategic communications, public affairs, advocacy and editorial production. I have worked for an intergovernmental organisation, a diplomatic mission, a national revenue authority and a financial sector association. The common thread is taking complex policy and technical subjects and making them clear to the people they affect.

My work covers the full range of an institution's communications: planning strategies, budgets and monitoring frameworks; writing speeches, statements and briefings for senior leaders; building relationships with journalists across several countries; running public education campaigns; and producing reports, briefs and multimedia stories. I handle sensitive subjects with care, from bilateral relations to community-level field research, and I work comfortably across cultures in English and Kinyarwanda, with basic French.

I am currently Regional Communications Specialist at NELSAP-CU, part of the Nile Basin Initiative, where I lead communications for transboundary water, energy and climate resilience projects. Before that I was Director of Communications at the Rwanda High Commission in Kampala. I hold a Master of Arts in Digital Journalism from Aga Khan University, and I am open to roles in development, climate, public affairs and international organisations.

experience.title: Regional Communications Specialist
experience.description: I lead strategic communications for an intergovernmental body coordinating water and energy investments in the Nile Equatorial Lakes region. I developed the FY2026/2027 Communications Plan, with its budget, quarterly workplan and monitoring framework, and I coordinate media, visibility and participation for regional events such as Nile Day 2026, ISM 10 and the 10th Nile Basin Journalists Training, which have generated more than 100 reported media placements in the region. I also write speeches, op-eds and executive content for the Regional Coordinator, edit the institutional newsletter, and produce project briefs, technical reports and campaigns, including flood early warning awareness for border communities.

experience.title: Director, Communications
experience.description: I led institutional communications and public diplomacy, shaping the mission's engagement with government, diplomatic and public audiences. I prepared speeches, briefings, statements and policy-facing content for senior officials, coordinated media relations and digital communications, and monitored sensitive bilateral and media developments to inform measured responses and official engagements.
